newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas upgraded.

text.p: -- Hilliard Lyons analyst Jeffrey Thomison said Monday he upgraded Regal Cinemas Inc to buy from hold due to a significant decline in the stock price.
-- In a report, he said the stock declined despite the company's "rapid growth plans and the industry's strong product pipeline."

-- He said the share price weakness reflects a sluggish box office during the Olympic Games as well as concerns about potential theater industry overcapacity in the future. He said box office receipts have rebounded and theater overcapacity is not a serious concern.
-- Thomison said Regal Cinemas "is the most impressive publicly held operator in the industry."
-- His two-year price objective on the stock is $36.
-- Regal Cinemas closed Friday at 24-3/4, up 5/16.
